name: Mousoukyou Zanatorium
source:
A world where Spiria, a virus that causes delusions and hallucinations, has become an epidemic.

The protagonist, Rui Genzaki, unfortunately gets infected with Spiria and begins to have hallucinations. His younger sister, Mone, takes him to Kamikawa Sanatorium Hospital. There he encounters his first love, Riza, the suspicious director, Anri, and strange monsters.

Is the world you see reality? Or is it delusion?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2586250/_/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这个世界里，Spiria（一种引起妄想和幻觉的病毒）已经成为一种流行病。

主角源崎瑠衣不幸感染了Spiria并开始产生幻觉。他的妹妹莫恩带他去了上川疗养院。在那里，他遇到了初恋情人莉莎、多疑的导演安里以及奇怪的怪物。

你看到的世界是真实的吗？还是错觉？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2586250/_/]Steam[/url]]
